# Code Quality & Architecture Checklist: Feature 046

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review checklist ("Unit Tests for Requirements") for code quality, strict typing, hook stability, and asset optimization  
**Created**: 2026-10-15  
**Feature**: [specs/046-code-quality-architecture/spec.md](file:///c:/Users/Rogerio%20Teixeira/OneDrive/Documentos/Antigravity/Metrik/specs/046-code-quality-architecture/spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## 1. Tipagem Estrita & Governança de Linter (Linting & Types Requirements Quality)

- [ ] CHK001 Are all 40 ESLint warnings explicitly inventoried and categorized by rule type in requirements? [Completeness, Spec §Context]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the replacement strategy for `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` specified with concrete domain types from `src/types/`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the elevation of `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` from warning to error explicitly documented as an enforcement gate? [Completeness, Spec §Clarifications.Q1]
- [ ] CHK004 Are unused variables and parameters in `syncService.ts` specified to be removed or prefixed with `_` to comply with lint conventions? [Clarity, Spec §US1.AC3]
- [ ] CHK005 Does the spec explicitly define zero tolerance (0 errors, 0 warnings) as an unyielding quality threshold? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]

## 2. Estabilidade de Hooks & Ciclo de Vida React (React Hooks Requirements Quality)

- [ ] CHK006 Are missing dependencies for `useCfdData.ts` (`customDateRange`) explicitly specified to be included in the memoization dependency array? [Completeness, Spec §US3.AC1]
- [ ] CHK007 Are stabilization mechanisms (`useCallback`, stable object references) specified for `useTeamAccess.ts` to prevent infinite re-render loops? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications.Q3]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the memoization requirement for `myTeams` in `BoardManagementModal.tsx` defined with clear boundaries against re-initialization? [Completeness, Spec §US3.AC3]
- [ ] CHK009 Does the spec specify that fixing hook dependencies must not alter the business trigger timings of data synchronization? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions]

## 3. Otimização de Assets & Desempenho de Bundle (Asset Optimization Requirements Quality)

- [ ] CHK010 Is the size threshold for `src/assets/metrik-logo.png` quantified with an objective target (< 120 KB or > 80% reduction)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK011 Is backward compatibility with existing image import paths explicitly specified to prevent breaking component references? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications.Q2]
- [ ] CHK012 Are visual fidelity constraints (alpha channel transparency, zero dark-theme fringing artifacts) defined? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 Is bundle footprint measurement required as part of the production build verification? [Measurability, Spec §FR-006]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
